description: CONTRACT_SPEC.md §9.1 ingest_mode='file' + §7.5 file ingest: a finished recording whose length is an EXACT multiple of max_chunk_bytes chops into N equal plaintext batches (batch i = file[i*max_chunk_bytes : (i+1)*max_chunk_bytes]). Concatenating the per-batch plaintexts in batch_sequence order reproduces the input byte-for-byte. CLIENT-SIDE property only — chunk then reassemble; NO Cephios decryption, NOT the Phase 2 export feature (R-RT-CLIENTSIDE). 8-byte input, 4-byte chunks -> 2 batches.
notes: Deterministic: byte-identical or broken, no edge-case slack (R-RT-GATED, §17.3 100%). reassembled_hex MUST equal file_bytes_hex.

description: CONTRACT_SPEC.md §9.1/§7.5 file ingest: a recording whose length is NOT a multiple of max_chunk_bytes produces a final short remainder batch. 10-byte input, 4-byte chunks -> batches of 4, 4, 2. Concatenation in batch_sequence order reproduces the input. Client-side only (R-RT-CLIENTSIDE).
notes: The remainder batch (batch_sequence 2) carries the final 2 bytes; the reassembler is length-preserving.

description: CONTRACT_SPEC.md §9.1/§7.5 file ingest: a recording SMALLER than max_chunk_bytes produces exactly one batch (batch_sequence 0) carrying the whole file. 3-byte input, 8-byte chunks -> 1 batch. Concatenation reproduces the input. Client-side only (R-RT-CLIENTSIDE).
notes: Single-chunk file (< chunk size): one batch, whole file. Lower bound of the chunker.
